result: Let R be any PPT nonnegative diagonal weighted 5x5 grid operator of https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12966v1 Figure 2. For Alice tail kernels contained in span{|3>,|4>}, the entire complex CP1 is SN<=2 whenever beta*q>=alpha*c. For Bob tail kernels the entire CP1 is SN<=2 whenever delta*q>=alpha*b. Here alpha,beta,delta,b,c,mu,q are the weights of A=|02>+|11>+|20>, V=|01>, W=|10>, B=|12>+|34>, C=|21>+|43>, |00>, Q=|22>+|33>, respectively. An arbitrary local map may act on the opposite side. The original trace18 PPT/SN3 grid has all these weights1, satisfies both balance conditions at equality, and therefore EVERY such 4x4 output is PPT/SN<=2. This strictly extends the previous trace24 source and dominated cone; it does not settle generic 4x4 PPT states.
ppt_prerequisites: If alpha=0, every source generator has SR<=2 and the result is immediate. If alpha>0, source PPT implies mu*q>=alpha^2 and delta*c>=alpha^2 from the respective PT principal submatrices on |00>,|22> and |10>,|21>. It also implies beta*b>=alpha^2 from |01>,|12>. In particular all displayed weights are positive. Only the first two minors and the additional beta*q>=alpha*c balance are needed for the Alice argument.
normal_form_and_parameters: For a finite Alice tail chart take K|0,1,2,4>=|0,1,2,3>, K|3>=t|3>, so ker K=span{|3>-t|4>}. For t=0 use the one-coordinate theorem in frontier-20261028-grid55-one-coordinate-arbitrary-opposite-v1.json SHA256 d17fe2163bd7181e00af10ae6a3a5a933b355a06dad3866e52ee32a252a122a1. For U=|t|^2>0 put r=q*U/c, p=1/(1+r), s=r/(1+r), a0=sqrt(mu/p), w=sqrt(delta/s), c0=alpha*s/w, lambda=(p/s)*t. Then p+s=1 and w*c0=alpha*s. After projection C'=|21>+|33>, Q'=|22>+t|33>; define Y=Q'-tC'=|22>-t|21> and Z=C'-Q'/t=-(1/t)Y.
two_phase_seeds: For every z^4=1 set b_z=sqrt(alpha)*(A'-tV')+z*a0|00>+conjugate(z)*(alpha/a0)Y, and c_z=sqrt(alpha)*(A'+lambda V')+z*w W'+conjugate(z)*c0 Z. Each has SR<=2. For b_z the first three head rows are [z*a0,-t*sqrt(alpha),sqrt(alpha)], [0,sqrt(alpha),0], and [sqrt(alpha),-t*conjugate(z)*alpha/a0,conjugate(z)*alpha/a0]; row3 is sqrt(alpha)*conjugate(z)/a0 times row1, and the fourth Alice row is zero. For c_z the head determinant is sqrt(alpha)*((1+lambda/t)*w*c0-alpha)=0, because 1+lambda/t=1/s. Its fourth Alice row also vanishes. Orthogonality yields the corresponding four-phase averages without cross terms between the three phase groups.
residual_gram: The mixture p*T_b+s*T_c consumes alpha[A']+alpha*U*p/s[V']+mu[00]+delta[W']; cross A'/V' terms cancel because -p*t+s*lambda=0. Since p/s=1/r=c/(q*U), the V cost is alpha*c/q<=beta by the balance hypothesis. On (C',Q') the remaining Gram is H=diag(c,q)-alpha^2*(p^2/mu+s^4/(delta*U))*(-t,1)*(-t,1)^*. Every vector in span(C',Q') occupies only Alice rows2,3, so an H PSD factorization is an SR2 sum. The remaining other source generators are SR<=2 with nonnegative weights.
universal_gram_bound: The rank-one PSD criterion is alpha^2*(p^2/mu+s^4/(delta*U))*(U/c+1/q)<=1. From mu*q>=alpha^2 and delta*c>=alpha^2 the left side is at most (q*p^2+c*s^4/U)*(U/c+1/q)=(1+r)*p^2+(1+1/r)*s^4=1/(1+r)+r^3/(1+r)^3. This equals 1-(r+2r^2)/(1+r)^3<1 for every r>0. Thus the Gram is strictly PSD for every finite nonzero t, independent of its phase. The missing CP1 point ker K=span{|4>} is a coordinate deletion; surjective maps with the same kernel differ by an invertible output filter.
bob_and_opposite_maps: Tensor-factor swap preserves PPT and sends V<->W, B<->C, |14><->|41>, |23><->|32>, while A,|00>,Q remain fixed. Applying the Alice proof to the swapped weighted source gives the Bob balance condition delta*q>=alpha*b. A local map on the opposite side cannot increase Schmidt rank in the resulting explicit decomposition, so it is completely arbitrary, including any rank-four map to form 4x4 outputs. PPT is preserved under local congruence.
original_example: For the original source all seven indicated weights are1, so both balance conditions hold exactly. The source trace is18 and its PPT/SN3 claims are from the cited paper; the predecessor independently checked its 25x25 PT. At t=3/4 the exact parameters are p=16/25,s=9/25,a0=5/4,w=5/3,c0=27/125,lambda=4/3. The V budget is exhausted exactly and the Gram scalar cost is 10729/15625<1. Thus the actual 4x5 and 5x4 cuts, and arbitrary opposite local images including 4x4, have SN<=2.

exact_check.observed: For both Alice and Bob at t=3/4, all 3x3 minors of eight phase vectors vanish exactly, all 400 entries of each actual decomposition match, mixed-Gram pivots are [294064/390625,7650/18379], and the actual PT is PSD. The checker hash-pins and replays the prior trace24 full-tail example and its upstream rectangular/coordinate cases. Universal complex t and general weighted balance follow from the explicit algebra and scalar bound.

limits: The source must be PPT and lie in the indicated nonnegative diagonal 5x5 grid family, with the indicated balance for the side whose tail kernel is used. Other kernel planes, two arbitrary non-coordinate kernels, arbitrary 4x4 PPT states, the requested SN>=3 witness, independent/formal review and novelty remain open.
